run_parse_musicnet_cli: run the parse_musicnet CLI with --input and --output args to organize MusicNet WAV files by composer and ensemble
run_process_labels: run process_labels to parse CSV label files into IntervalTrees mapping note intervals to instrument and beat data
build_musicnet_subset: build a MusicNet data subset by copying WAV files grouped by composer and ensemble into separate output directories
review_process_labels: review the process_labels function that reads CSV files and builds IntervalTree structures for musical note annotations
summarize_main: summarize the main function that filters MusicNet metadata by composer and ensemble domains then copies corresponding WAV files
